about: S07.6 (D.7): every control a family sees in the Wallet and the Family Hub, what the product may say it does, where the system enforces it and which adversarial test proves it. agent/tools/check-no-unbacked-guarantee.mjs fails CI when an enforcement or a proof is missing, when the latest definition of an enforcing SQL function no longer carries its guard, when a surface declares a data-control that is not listed here, or when Core's or the client's freeze holds differ from the holds listed here. Rationale: docs/operations/NO-UNBACKED-GUARANTEE.md.

retiredClaims.why: D.17 lets a Tutor pre-approve small rewards and self-logged chores, so not every reward or chore waits for a tap (control approval); D.14 sends Share coins to a place a Tutor chose, never to another person's goal (control share_destination). Retired in S07.8 from the legacy marketing namespace, held out of the rebuilt public site (W2 Lane 1) that replaced it; the legacy namespace itself was deleted in S10L.3.

controls.claim: The account is a practice card: coins stay in the app. There is no bank, card number, card network or payment behind it.

provedBy.contains: serves the account as a declared simulation with no card number and every real freeze hold
refuses a card that is not a declared simulation, carries a number, or claims a hold nobody enforces
never serves a card-shaped number, even from a row stored before the column was dropped (D.7)

controls.claim: A freeze is real: while it holds, the four holds below are refused by the database for every writer, and nothing already in a pocket moves.

provedBy.contains: raise AssertionError('Frozen request was accepted')
preserves the pending credit and explains the hold

controls.claim: While frozen, a new reward request, a Tutor's approval and a level's pre-approval are all refused.

provedBy.contains: INSERT INTO redemptions(kid_user_id,catalog_id)
toBe('ACCOUNT_FROZEN')

controls.claim: While frozen, an approved chore's coins and an allowance wait to be split; they are not lost.

provedBy.contains: assert allocate()=='f'
resumes the split only after the child's own freeze is lifted and re-read

controls.claim: While frozen, the scheduled allowance and savings bonus are not posted; they catch up after the freeze is lifted.

provedBy.contains: run_due_scheduled_credits('{kid}');")=='0'
D.1 does not advance scheduled allowances while the account is frozen

controls.claim: While frozen, the child can neither give Share coins to a place nor take a gift back.

provedBy.contains: share and the freeze (D.1)

controls.claim: A child lifts only a freeze they set; a Tutor's freeze is lifted only by a Tutor.

provedBy.contains: 'FREEZE_OWNED_BY_GUARDIAN')
toBe('GUARDIAN_FREEZE')
a child may lift only a freeze they set

controls.claim: A reward request that would go over the Tutor's limit (the last 7 or 30 days of spending) is refused when it is asked for, whoever writes it.

provedBy.contains: 'SPEND_LIMIT_REACHED')
toBe('SPEND_LIMIT_REACHED')

controls.claim: A chore counts and a reward is given only after a Tutor's yes, or inside the independence level a Tutor granted (a self-logged chore or a pre-approved reward the Tutor reviews afterwards), and never past the freeze or the limit. The marketing site says exactly this, not that every reward waits for a tap (S07.8).

provedBy.contains: 'TASK_SELF_LOG_FORBIDDEN')
'REDEMPTION_PREAPPROVAL_FORBIDDEN')
reports a pre-approved reward as the database decided, and never approves one itself

controls.claim: Share coins go only to a place a Tutor (or a self-registered teen) chose, and only whoever chose it records what really happened, with a note the child reads. The marketing site describes this destination, not a transfer to someone else's goal (S07.8).

provedBy.contains: 'SHARE_DESTINATION_UNAVAILABLE')
'SHARE_GIFT_FORBIDDEN')

controls.claim: Under 13 (or with no known birth date) the bonus is 1 coin for every 10 saved and no percentage reaches the child, whoever writes the rule.

provedBy.contains: 'SAVINGS_BONUS_FIXED_FOR_AGE')

controls.claim: The presentation register follows age evidence, never role, and the teen register is exactly the percentage bonus framing.

provedBy.contains: D.12 and D.11 are one design
young: the limit is what is left and the month is three totals

controls.claim: A child's research data is recorded only while a verified Tutor's yes stands (an adult's own yes for an adult), never as an experiment, and a no, including the child's own, deletes every snapshot at once.

enforcedBy.contains: DELETE FROM public.family_research_participants WHERE subject_user_id = p_subject

provedBy.contains: saying no deletes
lets %s read their own participation and say no, as the caller

controls.claim: Each period the family reads (photos, records, usage insights, research) is the one the nightly retention job enforces, and deleting an account deletes all of it.

provedBy.contains: the sweep deletes what is past its period and nothing else
erasure removes every Block D row about them
the retention periods the family reads are the ones family_retention_days() enforces

controls.claim: What a Tutor writes in the reflective prompt stays in their browser unless they send it as the note or the reason; only whether it was written, shared or skipped is sent.

provedBy.contains: words here unless they choose to send them

controls.claim: The bridge's split tool applies the teen's usual split to a real amount in the browser and sends nothing; no amount, bank or account detail is ever stored.
